id: Greentea Peng tickets-Meow Nui, Wellington, New Zealand-Ticketek
name: Greentea Peng tickets
long_description:
Presented by: Astral People & Handsome Tours
Neo-soul artist Greentea Peng arrives in Australia and New Zealand this November, delicately infusing hypnotic dub with seductive hip-hop swings and jazzy neo-soul excursions.
The South London born Greentea Peng is an artist whose work is guided by self-inquiry, shaped by the dualities she inhabits: pain and pleasure, engagement and withdrawal, expression and stillness. Her emotional literacy is transformed into a blend of neo-soul, dub and jazz, all draped in psychedelic textures.
After rediscovering her love for music while travelling - where she joined a local band in Mexico - a renewed sense of self-confidence propelled her return to London and the release of her 2018 EP, Sensi. The project marked the beginning of a distinctive sound carved from heavy, weighty narration, dubby grain, hissy textures and sparse arrangements. The six-track release is anchored by negative space that sits tightly side-chained to the kick, creating a breathing, pumping feel, while minimal melodic movements allow tension to build and swell around her earthy, soulful voice.
This early foundation continued to evolve, punctuated by notable moments such as her performance of "Downers" on COLORS, which garnered millions of views, as well as her television debut on Later... with Jools Holland on the BBC, where she performed her breakout track "Hu Man". These milestones paved the way for her 2021 debut album, MAN MADE, which she described as a record designed to resonate "more in your heart space, and less in your headspace".
Her latest offering, TELL DEM IT'S SUNNY, dives deeper into her enduring practice of self-witnessing - a work of affirmation, emotional maturity and radical self-acceptance. From "BALI SKIT PT. 1", a soundscape that rises and falls like the ribcage of a shadowy spirit, to "RAW", where we're once again met with Peng's poignant voice notes, the album showcases an artist continuing to explore her inner world with clarity and conviction.
Now, the psychedelic R&B soulstress returns to Australia and New Zealand this November, bringing her rich catalogue of deeply personal, genre-defying music to audiences once again.

id: Paleface Swiss, Counterparts & Fox Lake tickets-Meow Nui, Wellington, New Zealand-Ticketek
name: Paleface Swiss, Counterparts & Fox Lake tickets
long_description:
Presented by: ThePhoenix.au
PALEFACE SWISS are the fastest rising force in heavy music today. Anyone who has borne witness to their live shows, critics and fans alike, can attest that their dominance is unassailable. Their trajectory unstoppable.
Hailing from Zürich, Paleface Swiss formed in 2017 and have rapidly climbed the ranks of the global heavy music scene with each album and EP. Frontman Marc “Zelli” Zellweger’s commanding vocals, paired with crushing riffs from guitarist Yannick Lehmann, thunderous bass from Tommy Lee, and pummelling drums courtesy of Luigi Paraventi, delivering a sound that blends old-school hardcore brutality with a full array of modern heaviness.
Joining the fray for this run of shows are Canadian metalcore legends, COUNTERPARTS and Colorado's heavyweight contenders, FOX LAKE.
COUNTERPARTS, fronted by metalcore's irrepressible poet laureate and agent provocateur, Brendan Murphy, are headliners in their own rights having already smashed their way around Australia to sell-out crowds and great acclaim.
Hamilton, Ontario's Counterparts are one of, if not the most respected names in the scene with a well earned a reputation for electrifying live performances and deeply personal songwriting that resonates with fans worldwide.
Putting the icing on this already insane tour are FOX LAKE. Formed in 2017 in Denver, Colorado, Fox Lake fuse heavy riffs, hip-hop, relentless energy and hardcore attitude into a powerful live spectacle. They are a growing global presence and redefining heavy music on their own terms.
